jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Throughout the day, you advise a project team on export control aspects for a potential project in an embargoed country and participate in a hub export control call with business partners from a specific region. You evaluate a case involving a partner on the sanctions list and clear SAP export control blocks for eligible transactions while also discussing export control aspects of a new factory in China with the executive management. To wrap up your day, you plan the content for a briefing meeting related to technology transfer for R&D colleagues.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a trusted Export Control Business Partner for the TI Business Area, providing professional and risk-conscious export control consultation across products, services, and projects globally.
* Oversee strategic export control topics for TI, connecting with Export Control Business Partners from all regions and collaborating closely with related functions such as the Export Control Governance and Classification Teams.
* Conduct risk-based evaluations of critical business transactions using the Gloria tool, making decisions on approvals, conditions, mitigations, or no-go scenarios as necessary.
* Make strategic export control decisions, including resolving complex red flags, handling escalations, and briefing senior management.
* Manage licensing needs by preparing, submitting, and overseeing license applications while ensuring compliance with license conditions and assessing U.S. EAR and ITAR implications.
* Interpret and apply EU, US, and other sanctions regulations to transactions, conduct end-use/end-user checks, participate in audits, and deliver export control training to relevant business groups.

What You Bring

* Hold a degree in law, business administration, economics, engineering, or a related field, and bring extensive of hands-on experience in export control within complex, international project or product environments (energy, industrial, or comparable sectors).
* Demonstrate expert knowledge of EU Dual-Use Regulation, relevant national laws (e.g., AWG/AWV), U.S. export controls (EAR; familiarity with ITAR is beneficial), and sanctions frameworks (EU/US/others) with practical transactional application.
* Operate EX processes and controls in ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and utilize external and internal professional databases/sources (e.g., Dow Jones, Sanctions Matrix).
* Exhibit strong risk management, critical thinking, and decision-making skills while balancing business priorities with non-negotiable export control compliance requirements.
* Communicate effectively and manage stakeholders, explaining complex regulations in business-friendly terms and constructively challenging when necessary.
* Maintain high integrity, resilience, and sound judgment, feeling comfortable making and standing behind go/no-go calls in ambiguous, time-sensitive contexts, and speak fluent English, with additional language skills (e.g., German) being advantageous.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

You lead the commodity agenda for electrical insulation and copper materials for Large Generator products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. 

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Generator portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy for Electrical Insulation components e.g. Insulating Tapes (Mica, OCP, ICP etc.), Rigid Components like Prepreg, Rings, EPGx (sheets and machined profiles), Ropes, Tubes and Laminates. Additionally responsible for commodity management of Copper based material like Copper Flats, Insulated Flat Wires, Sheets, Profiles etc. in machined form. 
* Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end to end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations. 
* Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Generator demand. 
* Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area. 
* Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures. 
* Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond. 

What You Bring

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting. 
* Familiarity with generator insulation systems and copper products (e.g., profiles, bars, wire, sheet) or adjacent electrical materials. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key. 
* Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modeling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management. 
* Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers. 
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.)

This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide.

- Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives.
- Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D projects.
- Performs tasks/projects and takes the responsibility for assuring quality, cost effectiveness & timeliness for those projects
- Develop materials and processes while supporting related projects.
- Maintain regular reporting on project progress and outcomes.
- Supervise customer sample preparation and optimize products based on feedback.
- Monitor technical advancements in the market, including patents and scientific publications.
- Consolidate fundamental knowledge on steel casting fluxes and associated raw materials.

- Plan research activities, including experiments, characterization, and analytics
